title: CPRIT: Patient Adherence to Lung Cancer Screening
official: CPRIT: Patient Adherence to Lung Cancer Screening
summary: To understand participants' barriers to lung cancer screening and their experience with scheduling lung cancer screening.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Current smoker or quit within the past 15 years
* A 20+ pack-year smoking history
* Healthy enough for treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not applicable as our focus is on patients with an order for screening at the UTMB or UT Tyler
